switcher.allTeamsHint: Combine every team in one view

profile.title: Tell me what you do
profile.lede: What you put here is what I'll use to pick which task lands on your desk. The preview on the right updates as you go.

toasts.githubConnected: Connected. I'll start looking at your commits — first results land in a moment.
toasts.githubConnectFailed: Couldn't connect to GitHub. Try again in a moment.
toasts.kept: Kept. Counts when I match tasks.
toasts.updateFailed: Couldn't update. Try again in a moment.
toasts.rescanRateLimited: Already scanned recently. Try again in {min}m.
toasts.scanFailed: Couldn't run a scan. Try again in a moment.
toasts.connectStartFailed: Couldn't start GitHub connect. Try again.
toasts.disconnectFailed: Couldn't disconnect. Try again in a moment.
toasts.miningStopped: Stopped. I'll keep the skills you've accepted.

savebar.errorNoSkill: Add at least one skill before saving.
savebar.errorGeneric: Couldn't save just now. Try again.
savebar.savedDegraded: Saved. I'll re-match the canonical tags next time the LLM is reachable.
savebar.saved: Saved. Recgon will use this on the next run.

skills.label: Skills
skills.placeholder: Type to search — e.g. React, Python, Figma

strengths.label: Strengths
strengths.helper: What you're known for. Counts the same as skills when I match tasks.
strengths.placeholder: Type to add — e.g. shipping fast, debugging

interests.label: Interests
interests.helper: What you'd lean into. Breaks ties when two of you fit equally.
interests.placeholder: Type to add — e.g. design systems, AI agents

capacity.label: Weekly capacity
capacity.helper: How many hours you have for new work in a typical week.

consent.heading: What GitHub says about you
consent.body1: If you connect GitHub, I'll look at the commits you've authored in this team's repos over the last 6 months and suggest skills that match what you've actually been shipping. You stay in control — every suggestion is yours to keep or reject.
consent.body2: I only read commits in repos already connected to this team. Commit titles only. Never your personal repos, never private notes.
consent.connectedLine: Connected {who}. I'll re-check weekly and add new suggestions to your preview.
consent.dialogBody: I'll keep the skills you've already accepted — they're real, even if you don't want me looking at new commits. The ones you've rejected stay rejected.

inferred.heading: What GitHub spotted in your code
inferred.helper: Keep what fits, drop what doesn't — your call.
inferred.rateLimitTooltip: Already scanned recently. Next scan available in {min}m.
inferred.notConsented: Once you connect GitHub, I'll add suggested skills here based on the commits you've actually shipped.
inferred.keptTooltip: I'm using this when matching tasks to you.
inferred.dropTooltip: Drop this from my profile. Permanent — I won't suggest it again.

llm_commit.tooltip: From commit titles you authored in the last 6 months.

linguist.tooltip: From the languages GitHub sees in this team's repos.

extension.tooltip: From file extensions in commits you authored.

llm_import.tooltip: From import statements in files you've changed.

empty.default: I haven't scanned your commits yet. Click <key>Re-scan</key> to start.

noTeamRepos.title: No GitHub repos to scan
noTeamRepos.body: Add a project with a GitHub URL to this team and I'll start mining commits the next time we scan.

noToken.title: GitHub connection lost
noToken.body: I'm consented to mine, but I don't have a valid GitHub token for your account. Reconnect to fix this.

noConsent.title: GitHub mining isn't on
noConsent.body: I don't have permission to look at your commits. Reconnect to grant it.

noAuthor.title: I don't know your GitHub username
noAuthor.body: The connection saved your account but not your username. Reconnect to fill it in.

couldntInfer.title: Couldn't infer skills
couldntInfer.bodyOne: I read <key>{count}</key> commit but couldn't tie them to a clear skill. Descriptive commit messages help — “feat: add Stripe checkout” tells me more than “fixes”.
couldntInfer.bodyOther: I read <key>{count}</key> commits but couldn't tie them to a clear skill. Descriptive commit messages help — “feat: add Stripe checkout” tells me more than “fixes”.

expired.title: Your GitHub connection expired
expired.body: GitHub no longer accepts the token I have for you. Reconnect to start fresh.

noRepoScope.title: GitHub didn't grant access to your code
noRepoScope.body: Your GitHub connection has <key>profile</key> and <key>email</key> access, but not <key>repositories</key>. Reconnect, and on GitHub's authorization screen make sure every permission stays checked.

blocked.title: GitHub blocked every repo
blocked.body: Your connection has the right permissions, but GitHub refused to list commits for all <key>{count}</key> of this team's repos. Most common cause: one of your organizations on GitHub uses single sign-on and hasn't enabled third-party access for this app.

noRecentCommits.title: No recent commits
noRecentCommits.bodyOne: I checked <key>{count}</key> repo but saw no commits in the last 6 months. Push something and I'll re-check.
noRecentCommits.bodyOther: I checked <key>{count}</key> repos but saw no commits in the last 6 months. Push something and I'll re-check.

almostThere.title: Almost there — try again
almostThere.body: GitHub showed me your recent commits, but the filtered query came back empty. This sometimes happens right after a fresh connection. Hit Try again in a minute.

emailMismatch.title: Your commits don't match your GitHub account
emailMismatch.bodyWithEmail: Your last commit was authored by <key>{email}</key>. That email isn't on <key>{who}</key>, so GitHub doesn't link it to you.
emailMismatch.bodyNoEmail: I saw recent commits, but none of them are tied to <key>{who}</key>.
emailMismatch.addEmailHint: Add it to your GitHub emails, or set <key>git config user.email</key> to one of: <key>{emails}</key>.

emailPrivate.title: Your GitHub email is private
emailPrivate.body: Your commits use one of your verified GitHub emails, but <key>Keep my email addresses private</key> is on — so GitHub stops attributing them to <key>{who}</key>. Turn it off and I'll find your skills.

noAttributed.title: No commits to read
noAttributed.bodyOne: I checked <key>{count}</key> repo but didn't see any commits attributed to <key>{who}</key>. Push something and I'll re-check.
noAttributed.bodyOther: I checked <key>{count}</key> repos but didn't see any commits attributed to <key>{who}</key>. Push something and I'll re-check.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.empty: Start declaring skills on the left and you'll see what tasks I'd send your way.

admin.loadFailedHint: Team, members and invites couldn't be fetched. Your data is fine — try again.

config.nameHint: Shown in the sidebar, hero, and member rosters.
config.descriptionHint: A one-line summary. Up to 120 characters.
config.avatarHint: Upload an image, or pick a color swatch.

danger.title: danger zone
danger.subtitle: Irreversible operations.
danger.leaveHint: You will lose access to all projects in this team — analyses, tasks, marketing plans, the lot.
danger.deleteHint: All projects, members, and data will be permanently deleted. Cannot be undone.
